label: Fish Ancestry Scroller
purpose: Review-stage page that renders three numbered layers + brick metrics + cohort summary for one selected inversion candidate (one chromosome viewport). Consumer of shared ancestry primitives — does NOT compute alignment or bricks itself; caller supplies a fully prepared model to mount().
input_contract: model (passed to mount) — derived from shared/ancestry_alignment.js + shared/ancestry_bricks.js

panels.purpose: PC1 Band per fish (Layer 1 of UI spec v2)
Overview / Candidates / Ancestry / Pop Stats / Regimes / Markers / Breakpoints
3 blocks — Context explainer / View-mode + overlay controls / (third block)

subdir_files: layers.js — renderers for the 3 numbered layers + brick metrics block
selection.js — brick hit-test (Layer 2 canvas click → brick under pixel)
primitives_used: shared/ancestry_alignment.js (produces aligned Q with label-switching fixed — drives Layer 2 brick K assignment + ΔQ metric)
shared/ancestry_bricks.js (produces per-fish bricks + flags — drives Layer 2 and brick-metrics block)
adapters_used: unknown — model is supplied by caller, not loaded internally
label_alignment_critical_path: F-based label-switching alignment pipeline (Q-fallback only in flanks; regime-aware smoothing; FAIL = grey not coloured)

interactions.purpose: Layer 2 click → resolve brick under pixel

computed_preview_outputs: Layer 2: Ancestry Bricks per fish (six color modes)

documents.page_registry_doc: NOT registered — page not in pages.registry.json and not in atlases/inversion/manifest.json

known_issues: Ancestry bricks layer is a DERIVED simplification merging RFs into bricks with multi-metric labels (RARE_ANCESTRY, HIGH_HET, REGIME_DISCORDANT, etc.). NOT a discovery system — 'we discovered N bricks' is forbidden phrasing per the SPEC.
Consumes instant_q (Engine B) per-RF output — cluster-side producer integration not yet wired.
Caller must supply a fully prepared `model` to mount() — model derivation from raw atlasState.inversion not yet automatic.
